verdict_summary: High-risk, high-velocity bet. He can ship multi-agent features on day one with zero ramp cost, but his tenure pattern (3 jobs in 3.5 years, 7 months at Voltrix) screams flight risk. I risk paying 6 months of salary only to watch him jump ship for another 20% bump.

strengths.claim: Zero ramp-up required on multi-agent freight ops architecture
Production experience with 5,000+ monthly freight exceptions

gaps.claim: Severe retention risk with 3 jobs in 3.5 years, explicitly motivated by quick title and pay hops
Untested in high-incident production volume despite on-call claims
